mapper.sql: u.occurred_at >= DATE_ADD(#{from}, INTERVAL 9 HOUR) AND u.occurred_at < DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)

COALESCE(SUM(u.call_count), 0) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(u.input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(u.cached_input_tokens), 0) AS cached_input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(u.output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(u.estimated_cost_usd), 0) AS estimated_usd, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.estimated_cost_usd IS NULL THEN u.call_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unpriced_calls, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN u.cache_write_input_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(SUM(u.cache_write_input_tokens), 0) END AS cache_write_input_tokens, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN u.cache_write_12h_input_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(SUM(u.cache_write_12h_input_tokens), 0) END AS cache_write_12h_input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.cache_write_input_tokens IS NULL OR u.cache_write_12h_input_tokens IS NULL THEN u.call_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS incomplete_usage_calls
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_usage_record (occurred_at, usage_date, account_id, feature, operation, model, service_tier, call_count, input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, output_tokens, estimated_cost_usd, price_id, cache_write_input_tokens, cache_write_12h_input_tokens) VALUES (#{occurredAt}, #{usageDate}, #{accountId}, #{feature}, #{operation}, #{model}, #{serviceTier}, #{callCount}, #{inputTokens}, #{cachedInputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{estimatedCostUsd}, #{priceId}, #{cacheWriteInputTokens}, #{cacheWrite12hInputTokens})
mapper.select: SELECT id, model_prefix, service_tier, input_usd_per_million, cached_input_usd_per_million, output_usd_per_million, effective_from, note, created_by_account_id, created_at, cache_write_input_usd_per_million, cache_write_12h_input_usd_per_million FROM ai_model_price ORDER BY model_prefix, service_tier, effective_from DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_model_price (model_prefix, service_tier, input_usd_per_million, cached_input_usd_per_million, output_usd_per_million, effective_from, note, created_by_account_id, created_at, cache_write_input_usd_per_million, cache_write_12h_input_usd_per_million) VALUES (#{modelPrefix}, #{serviceTier}, #{inputUsdPerMillion}, #{cachedInputUsdPerMillion}, #{outputUsdPerMillion}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{note}, #{createdByAccountId}, #{createdAt}, #{cacheWriteInputUsdPerMillion}, #{cacheWrite12hInputUsdPerMillion})
mapper.select: SELECT u.feature AS group_key, FROM ai_usage_record u WHERE GROUP BY u.feature ORDER BY estimated_usd DESC, calls DESC
SELECT u.model AS group_key, u.service_tier, FROM ai_usage_record u WHERE GROUP BY u.model, u.service_tier ORDER BY estimated_usd DESC, calls DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT DATE(DATE_SUB(u.occurred_at, INTERVAL 9 HOUR)) AS day, COALESCE(SUM(u.estimated_cost_usd), 0) AS estimated_usd, SUM(u.call_count) AS calls FROM ai_usage_record u WHERE GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT u.account_id, a.email, p.plan_code, FROM ai_usage_record u JOIN account a ON a.id = u.account_id LEFT JOIN account_plan p ON p.account_id = u.account_id WHERE GROUP BY u.account_id, a.email, p.plan_code ORDER BY estimated_usd DESC, calls DESC, u.account_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT cost_date AS day, SUM(amount_usd) AS estimated_usd, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM ai_cost_daily WHERE cost_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY cost_date ORDER BY cost_date
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_cost_daily WHERE cost_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_cost_daily (cost_date, project_id, line_item, amount_usd, fetched_at) VALUES (#{costDate}, #{projectId}, #{lineItem}, #{amountUsd}, #{fetchedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_provider_usage_daily WHERE usage_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_provider_usage_daily (usage_date, usage_kind, project_id, model, service_tier, batch_kind, call_count, input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, cache_write_input_tokens, cache_write_12h_input_tokens, output_tokens, estimated_cost_usd, price_id) VALUES (#{usageDate}, #{usageKind}, #{projectId}, #{model}, #{serviceTier}, #{batchKind}, #{callCount}, #{inputTokens}, #{cachedInputTokens}, #{cacheWriteInputTokens}, #{cacheWrite12hInputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{estimatedCostUsd}, #{priceId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_cost_sync_day WHERE usage_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_cost_sync_day (usage_date, project_scope, actual_usd, fetched_at) VALUES (#{usageDate}, #{projectScope}, #{actualUsd}, #{fetchedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT d.usage_date, d.project_scope, d.actual_usd, d.fetched_at, COALESCE(SUM(u.call_count), 0) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(u.input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(u.cached_input_tokens), 0) AS cached_input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(u.output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(u.estimated_cost_usd), 0) AS estimated_usd, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.estimated_cost_usd IS NULL THEN u.call_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unpriced_calls, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN u.usage_date IS NOT NULL AND u.cache_write_input_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(SUM(u.cache_write_input_tokens), 0) END AS cache_write_input_tokens, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN u.usage_date IS NOT NULL AND u.cache_write_12h_input_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(SUM(u.cache_write_12h_input_tokens), 0) END AS cache_write_12h_input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.cached_input_tokens IS NULL OR u.cache_write_input_tokens IS NULL OR u.cache_write_12h_input_tokens IS NULL THEN u.call_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS incomplete_usage_calls FROM ai_cost_sync_day d LEFT JOIN ai_provider_usage_daily u ON u.usage_date = d.usage_date WHERE d.usage_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND d.project_scope = #{scope} GROUP BY d.usage_date, d.project_scope, d.actual_usd, d.fetched_at ORDER BY d.usage_date
SELECT started_at FROM ai_cost_sync_state WHERE singleton_id = 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_cost_sync_state SET started_at = #{startedAt} WHERE singleton_id = 1
